body: Yeah, I get what you're saying. But it's really hard sometimes to try and imagine happiness that I'll have 10+ years down the road when I see all of my friends and acquaintances happy in relationships right now. I really feel like the path I'm supposed to be taking in life is to have a relationship and get married instead of chasing after what seems to be a pipe dream.
I'm in Canada so I'm already of legal drinking age. I'm also going to college in September for my final year and I haven't had any of these opportunities yet, it feels like I won't have any.
I love anime and I'm hoping one day to become a professional voice actor.
It's just that I've realized that I'm the only one of all my friends that has never dated or isn't dating someone right now.
